name: AI in Energy, Utilities and Natural Resources: The One-Hour Briefing
description: A free hour built around eight real jobs in power, oil and gas, water, agriculture and sustainability: drafting an outage summary without leaking BCSI, checking an AI load forecast, triaging AI vegetation flags, screening data-center load requests, acting on a satellite methane alert, ranking lead-line verifications, checking targeted spray against the label, and mapping Scope 3 spend. Each shows where AI helps, where it must not decide, and the rule that applies.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Energy, Utilities and Natural Resources

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 8 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 15 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
